provenance.method: Held-out: residuals score the PoseContext published by the Positioning service against AprilTags detected after each stop; no fit uses this run.

limitations: Covers the AprilTag-visible region around home, not the full ONVIF travel range.
All tags lie on the floor plane; errors are measured at 3.6-5.4 m range.
Zoom is fixed; the PoseContext contract does not model zoom.

provenance.notes: RMS over 173 AprilTag points of the verify run; tilt axis [1,0,0] camera_local is nominal (not fitted); full mechanical texture sweep [-1,1] on each axis; AprilTag validity is limited to the separately recorded tag-visible coverage. Do not interpret the mechanical limits as full-range AprilTag validation.
provenance.pose_calibration_method: AprilTag auto-calibration at the home position
